description: Issue #181, the other half of the measurement in 62: a literal `require` companion is still GATED on the declaration. The profile is byte-for-byte the one 62 uses, and this issue declares `web/src/app/map.mjs` — a path neither `scripts/{dir}{base}.mjs` nor `web/src/shared/{base}.mjs` matches — so `scripts/tests/shared-contract.test.mjs` must NOT appear. Without this case the feature could be "every literal is always granted", which would pass 62 and would be a profile-shaped version of the bare-glob permission invariant 1 forbids: the closure would stop being bounded by what the issue declared. L1's four `.mjs` shapes are all that is derived here.
